description: Modules copied into more than one chunk of the card bundle that hold no module-level state, each with the technical reason it holds none.

stateless.reason: Its only module-level value is a WeakMap memo from a config object to the module id -> entity map that flowModuleEntities derives from that config alone. A second copy derives an equal map for the same config; callers only read the map, no code compares maps from different copies, and the WeakMap keeps no config alive.
No module-level state of its own; its only top-level statement registers validateV2 in the single copy of src/anim-studio/model.ts, so a second evaluation registers an equivalent validator.
